name: Inline Loan Calculator Lite
author: guysoroka

sections.description:
Inline Loan Calculator Lite lets you easily add a modern, interactive loan or mortgage calculator inside WordPress — no coding required.
This Lite version includes a single calculator with clean design, responsive layout, and easy-to-use sliders.

✅ Features (Lite version)
– Create 1 loan calculator using shortcode [inline_loan_calculator id="123"]
– Adjustable loan amount, interest rate, and loan term sliders
– Automatic monthly payment calculation
– Simple color and width customization
– Lightweight, responsive design
– Works with all major page builders (Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi, Bricks, etc.)

💎 Upgrade to Pro for more features:
– 🔢 Unlimited calculators
– 🌍 Multi-language labels with RTL/LTR support
– 💰 Custom currency symbols ($, €, ₱, ₪, and more)
– 🎨 Advanced design options (fonts, hover colors, backgrounds, borders)
– 📊 Full amortization table (monthly breakdown of payments)
– 💾 Export amortization report as PDF
– 🧮 Additional repayment types (Spitzer, Equal Principal, Grace)
– 🔤 Custom labels and button texts
– 📞 Priority support & lifetime updates

👉 Upgrade to Pro
to unlock unlimited calculators, advanced repayment methods, RTL support, and more.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder inline-loan-calculator-lite to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it directly from your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through Plugins → Inline Loan Calculator Lite.
  3. Go to Inline Loan Calculator in your WordPress admin menu.
  4. Click Add New Calculator, set your parameters, and copy the shortcode.
  5. Paste the shortcode anywhere (page, post, or widget) to display your calculator.

Example shortcode:

[inline_loan_calculator id=”123″]
sections.faq:
Can I create more than one calculator?

Not in the Lite version — it’s limited to one calculator.
Upgrade to Pro for unlimited calculators and more advanced options.

Does it support multiple currencies?

Only the Pro version allows selecting or customizing your currency symbol.

Is it compatible with Elementor or Gutenberg?

Yes, absolutely! You can insert the shortcode anywhere inside your favorite builder.

Is RTL (Right-to-Left) layout supported?

RTL support is available in the Pro version. The Lite version uses LTR by default.
